scene_spec.object: A certificate for 'Outstanding Achievement in Environmental Stewardship' issued by the 'Regional Sustainability Council'. The certificate has a heading 'Certificate of Recognition', body text acknowledging 'Dr. Anya Sharma' for 'exemplary efforts in promoting sustainable practices', a 'Date of Issue: 2023-10-26', and a 'Recipient ID: RSC-7890'. There is a blank circular area in the bottom right corner, designated for an official seal. The rest of the document's content is clearly visible.
scene_spec.location: The entire certificate document is laid flat on a neutral light-colored surface, with its edges parallel to the image frame.

appearance.lighting: Soft, even studio lighting, casting minimal shadows
